name: Sal Celtica - Deja de usar sal común V3
master_prompt: Create ONE vertical 9:16 Spanish short-form UGC clip with native spoken audio for Sal Celtica. Each clip is one leaf scene only: one location, one camera setup, one visual idea, one exact spoken line. Tone: urgent, controversial, native TikTok, fast-paced, realistic kitchen UGC, not polished advertising. Keep claims framed as educational/marketing narrative, not medical advice. No miracle cures, no disease claims, no fake doctor language, no social UI, no captions baked into generated video.

hooks.title: Deja de usar sal común
hooks.subject_label: shocked UGC kitchen creator comparing plain table salt and flaky sea salt
hooks.subject_placement_hint: a surprised person in a lived-in kitchen holds a spoon or small plate of plain fine white table salt close to camera while a bowl of off-white translucent flaky sea salt sits nearby; no product packaging, no logos, no readable brands
hooks.script: Deja de usar sal común si no quieres seguir con antojos de medianoche.
hooks.prompt: Scroll-stopper first-frame thumbnail for a Spanish UGC reel: a surprised everyday person in a dim lived-in kitchen holds plain fine white table salt close to the phone camera with a worried 'wait, what?' expression. A small bowl of off-white translucent flaky sea salt is visible nearby as the contrast object. The flaky salt must match the attached grain reference: irregular fractured flakes, semi-translucent off-white crystals, dry coarse flakes, not gray gravel, not round pebbles. Native TikTok realism, handheld iPhone frame, imperfect kitchen lighting, dramatic but believable midnight snack tension. No product packaging, no logos, no readable labels, no text overlays, no subtitles baked into the image. Native dialogue: Deja de usar sal común si no quieres seguir con antojos de medianoche.
